messages.text: I want a taf that answers our support tickets the same day, and asks me before it promises anything.
Got it. Support replies will read new tickets in Zendesk and answer them. A reply that promises a refund, a discount or a replacement waits for your yes. Where do the tickets come in?
In Zendesk. Up to 40 replies a day, and never send a customer's details to anyone else.
Done: up to 40 replies a day, promises wait for you, and a customer's details never leave. Next I'll connect Zendesk, then you approve the Card.
